status: OPTIONAL ORIGINAL TEMP MUSIC/SFX — preview before enabling
provenance: Newly composed and synthesized for this project using local Python, NumPy/SciPy and FFmpeg. No samples, downloaded tracks, actor voices, or third-party compositions were used.
rights_note: Original generated project assets, provided for use in this project. This is not licensed Bluey/Peppa music and is not an imitation of either soundtrack. No third-party music license is bundled or required for source samples because none were used.

music.loop_note: 40-second near-loop with 15 ms endpoint fades. Prefer WAV and a 30–80 ms crossfade for repeated playback. MP3 decoder padding can introduce a tiny gap.
music.intended_use: Optional gentle instrumental bed during football silent montage. Keep off beneath narration unless separately reviewed; when needed reduce a further 8–12 dB.

quality_notes: Technically checked for sample rate, duration, finite samples, clipping and encoded readability.
No human listening review has been completed; this is a synthesized temp score, not a professionally produced final soundtrack.
Quiet target levels and soft attacks; playback loudness depends on device and application volume.
Music targeted at -25 LUFS; effects targeted at -30 to -32 LUFS with peak limits -16 to -17 dBTP. Short-effect loudness estimates are approximate.
